text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day has come again, and the

academy is wrapped in excitement. But
not
everyone is feeling festive...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This day always gets me a little blue...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and it was a total bummer... It was
during the
chocolate exchange last year.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make the younger students
happy, so
I worked really hard on their
gifts.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I tried to impress everyone by making
ganache,
which I thought was really
poppin' at the time...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so happy, but I didn't
realize the
truth until later—the big
ganache boom had
already come and
gone forever ago!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, it wasn't fine! I wanted everyone to
enjoy the
new hotness!
choice_data_list: It's delicious, so what's the problem?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm always trying to stay on top of the
most
tubular trends, so biffing it like
that was
mortifying...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't think Maruzensky being behind
the times
is limited to just this case...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't have any chocolate for
you,
Trainer. I just couldn't bear
something like that
happening again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't have any chocolate for
you,
Trainer. I just couldn't bear
something like that
happening again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Are you disappointed?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Psych! Just kidding! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're always so good to me, so of
course I'm
getting you something!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: C'mon, let's go get you some chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought we were just going to get
chocolate,
but it seems we're driving to
somewhere I've never
been...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, this is the place!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There are a ton of different shops here,
so pick
any chocolate you want!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you pick out your own chocolate, I
won't have
to worry about which one is
hot right now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you pick out your own chocolate, I
won't have
to worry about which one is
hot right now!
choice_data_list: You're picking out your own chocolate!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's all good! Just think of it like we're
out
shopping together!
choice_data_list: You're picking out your own chocolate!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy. Pick whatever you like! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky and I have a great time
picking out
chocolate together.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: This isn't just any chocolate, I'll have you know. It's a handcrafted, homemade confection!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This way I can show my appreciation
without
worrying about what's hot right
now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was practically bouncing around the
room when
I was making it! I kept
imagining your happy face
when you eat
it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...So, Trainer, where's your shoe cubby?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...So, Trainer, where's your shoe cubby?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, when you give someone
chocolate,
you put it in their shoe
cubby, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I made it just the right size to fit! So
c'mon, where
is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a pretty old-fashioned way to receive
a gift,
but I'm grateful all the same.
